title: Send via WhatsApp
subtitle: Enter a number to chat on WhatsApp
note: The number is used only to open the chat and is not saved.

results.number-invalid: That doesn’t look like a valid number. Enter the full number without the country code.
results.whatsapp-unavailable: The selected WhatsApp app isn’t installed.
results.launch-denied: Android blocked the launch. Try again.
results.idle-required: Turn on the shortcut switch on Home, then try again.
